ocr_samples: 水雪世界に咲き語る麗しの黒き蓄徹コンピネーシシンンららりり出される幕は漢士さえも溶かしつくす真紅の情熱!マイを馬鹿にすると私が本気出しちゃうから!
絵本の国に迷い込んだ一人ぼっちのプリンセス!究極の魔法を手にすればもう夢見る少女じゃいられない!
同じく氷のステージに舞い降りた純白の乙女!その微笑みは、天使のものが悪魔のものがそれは誰にも分からない彼女の笑顔を見て生きて帰った者はいないのだから
translations: Blooming in the world of water and snow, she speaks with grace. Her beautiful black hair and striking appearance are so enchanting that even a scholar would be melted by it. What a passionate expression of love! If anyone teases me, I’ll get serious instead!
A lonely princess who has stumbled into the world of picture books! Once she possesses the ultimate magic, she can no longer be just a dreamer.

Another maiden, pure and white, has also descended onto the ice stage. Her smile is so angelic yet also devilish… No one can truly understand her smile. No one who witnessed it has ever been able to return alive.
